blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Camera-controlled video generation anticipates how a scene appears from new viewpoints by relying on a prior learned implicitly from large-scale data. Ultrasound poses the same problem, with the probe pose as the viewpoint, but under opposite conditions: anatomy offers an explicit prior that every sonographer relies on, whereas tracked scans are too scarce to learn it implicitly. As a result, pose control alone is not enough, and pose-conditioned ultrasound generators produce implausible anatomy in unscanned regions and inconsistent anatomy on revisits. We go beyond pose control and give the generator the two kinds of knowledge that make up a sonographer's mental model. An anatomical prior, built from a population of subjects, guides generation where nothing has been scanned, and is refined online by every generated chunk towards the scanned subject. A 3D latent memory, designed around the cross-sectional physics of ultrasound, compounds the generated slices into a volume of the patient and reslices it at new poses, keeping revisited anatomy consistent. The fine-grained memory enters the generator at the input, while the coarse anatomy prior guides the layout across transformer blocks. Experiments on thyroid, kidney, and lumbar spine show improved visual fidelity, pose following, and anatomical consistency over pose-conditioned and memory-augmented baselines.
blocks.zh: 相机控制的视频生成通过依靠从大规模数据中隐含的事先学到的一面,来预测一个场景是如何从新角度出现的. 超声波也带来了同样的问题,探测器与视线一样外出,但是在相反的条件下:解剖学提供了每个音响学家所依赖的明确前兆,而跟踪扫描太少,无法隐含地学习. 因此,单靠姿势控制是不够的,而姿势条件的超声发电机在未被扫描的地区产生不可信的解剖学,在重访时进行不一致的解剖学. 我们超越了姿势控制,给了生成者两种知识,构成一个音响学家的精神模型. 解剖学先由一组人组成,引导没有扫描的一代人,并且由每个生成的块对扫描对象进行在线改进。 围绕超声波的截面物理学设计的3D潜伏记忆,将所生成的切片分解入患者的体积并被重新切入到新的姿势中,保持了重回解剖学的一致性. 精细的内存在输入时会进入生成器,而粗糙的解剖学前作指导了变压器块之间的布局. 对甲状腺、肾和腰椎的实验显示,视觉上的忠心性、姿势、解剖与姿势和记忆增强基线的一致性都有所改善。

blocks.en: 1  Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Humans navigate new environments with a mental prior learned from many similar ones. Entering an unfamiliar hotel room, we expect the bathroom near the door and the bed further inside; the exact layout differs from room to room, and every step refines our expectation. Video generation models [ 27 , 13 ] acquire a comparable prior from large-scale data, learning how scenes typically look and move. Camera-controlled video generation [ 29 , 14 , 4 ] builds on it to anticipate how a scene appears from a new viewpoint, but this prior remains implicit in the weights. Ultrasound (US) poses the same problem, with the probe pose as the viewpoint, yet under opposite conditions. Anatomy plays the role of the room layout: the relative positions of organs are shared across people and known to every expert sonographer, while their exact shape varies between individuals and becomes clear only as the scan proceeds.
blocks.zh: 人类在新环境的航行中,从许多类似的环境中吸取了精神上的经验。 进入一个不熟悉的酒店房间,我们期望靠近门的浴室和更远的里面的床;具体布局各有不同,每一步都会提高我们的预期. 视频生成模型[27,13]从大规模数据中获取一个可比较的前身,学习场景的典型外观和移动. 相机控制的视频生成 [29, 14, 4] 以此为基础, 预测一个场景是如何从新角度出现的, 但这个前作仍然隐含在重量中. 超声波(美国)也造成了同样的问题,探测器摆出视线,但在相反的条件下. 解剖学扮演了房间布局的角色:器官的相对位置由人共享并被每个专家作声学家所知晓,而它们的确切形状则因个人而异,只有在扫描过程中才变得清晰.

blocks.en: Unlike general-domain video generation, pose-tracked ultrasound data is limited, making it difficult to implicitly learn the relationship between probe poses and 3D anatomy. Moreover, robotic ultrasound [ 19 , 26 , 17 , 9 ] requires not only accurate pose following but also consistency with the underlying 3D anatomy [ 6 ] .
blocks.zh: 与一般域视频生成不同,平面跟踪的超声数据有限,因此很难隐含地学习出探测器平面与3D解剖学之间的关系. 此外,机器人超声波[19.、26.、17.、9]不仅需要准确的姿势,而且需要与基本的3D解剖学[6]保持一致。

blocks.en:
A sonographer’s mental model holds two kinds of knowledge: anatomical information, which predicts what lies in unscanned tissue, and a patient-specific 3D spatial volume, which preserves what has already been scanned. Existing ultrasound world models, such as SonoWorld [ 32 ] and UltraWorld [ 31 ] , learn anatomy implicitly from expanded training data but do not explicitly maintain both forms of knowledge during generation. Natural-video generators maintain such records through retrieved frames [ 33 , 30 ] or 3D caches [ 22 , 28 ] , but these rely on camera geometry, in which neighboring views overlap and can be reprojected.
An ultrasound image is instead a planar cross-section, and every out-of-plane motion reveals tissue that no earlier frame contains, so memory mechanisms designed for natural videos do not directly transfer to ultrasound.
blocks.zh:
一个音响学家的心理模型持有两种知识:解剖学信息,它预测了未被扫描的组织中存在的东西,以及患者特有的3D空间量,它保存了已经被扫描的东西. 现有的超声波世界模型,如SonoWorld[32]和UltraWorld[31],从扩展后的培训数据中隐含地学习解剖学,但并不在一代人期间明确保持这两种形式的知识. 自然-视频生成器通过取回的帧[33,30]或3D缓存[22,28]来维护这种记录,但这些都依赖于相机几何,其中相邻的视图相重叠,可以被再预测.
超声波影像取而代之是平面截面,每一次出飞机运动都揭示出没有更早帧所包含出的组织,因此为自然视频所设计的记忆机制不会被直接转移到超声波.

blocks.en: Anatomically consistent ultrasound generation requires three complementary capabilities: producing plausible anatomy in unseen regions, preserving it across revisits, and responding coherently to probe motion. We therefore go beyond pose control by providing two explicit forms of anatomical knowledge. (i) What guides generation in unseen regions? A population-level anatomical prior that, like the hotel-room expectation described earlier, is progressively refined by generated observations to adapt to the subject. (ii) What preserves anatomy across revisits? A 3D latent memory that compounds generated slices and reslices them at new probe poses, following ultrasound imaging geometry rather than camera projection. Together, the prior guides unseen anatomy while the memory preserves previously generated structures.
blocks.zh: 在解剖学上一致的超声波生成需要三种互补能力:在看不见的区域产生似是而非的解剖学,在重新审视时加以保存,对探测运动作出一致的反应。 因此,通过提供两种明确的解剖知识形式,我们超越了控制范围。 (一) 在看不见的区域指导如何生成? 人口层面的解剖学与前面所述的酒店-房间期望一样,通过生成的观测结果逐步完善,以适应这一主题。 (二) 哪些内容保留了复读的解剖学? 在超声波成像几何而非相机投影后,一种3D潜在内存,由化合物产生切片并重新在新探测器出场后进行重切. 之前的向导一起看不见解剖学,而内存则保存了以前产生的结构.

blocks.en: The two conditions play distinct roles: the memory provides fine-grained content at known locations, while the prior offers a coarse estimate of anatomical layout. We therefore inject them differently: memory is concatenated with the video latent at the input, whereas the prior guides early transformer blocks through residual conditioning. Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose an explicit anatomical prior for ultrasound video generation: a population model of anatomy that is updated online from the generated frames, so that it adapts the prior to the subject even in regions not yet scanned. • We propose a compounding-based 3D latent memory, the first memory for video generation designed around cross-sectional imaging rather than camera geometry, which keeps revisited regions consistent. • We propose a dual-path conditioning: the fine-grained memory is concatenated with the input, while the coarse prior is injected across transformer blocks to guide the layout without being treated as fine detail. Experiments on thyroid, kidney, and lumbar spine show that our framework outperforms existing models in fidelity, pose following, revisit consistency, and expert rating.
blocks.zh: 这两种条件具有不同的作用:内存在已知位置提供了精细的分量内容,而前作则提供了粗略的解剖布局估计. 因此,我们以不同的方式注入:内存由输入时潜入的视频相接而成,而前导的早期变压器块则通过剩余调节而成. • 我们的贡献概述如下: 我们提议在超声波视频生成之前进行明确的解剖:一个从生成的帧上在线更新的人口解剖模型,以便即使在尚未扫描的区域也能对之前的解剖进行调整。 我们提议一种基于复合的3D潜伏内存,这是第一个围绕截面成像而不是相机几何设计的视频生成内存,它使重回的区域保持一致。 我们提出一个双路径的调节:细纹内存与输入相接相接,而粗糙的前置被注入到变压器块之间来引导布局,而不作为细细的处理. 甲状腺、肾和脊椎的实验表明,我们的框架在忠诚度上超过了现有的模型,构成跟踪、重新审视一致性和专家评级。

blocks.en: 2  Related Works
blocks.zh: 2 相关工程

blocks.en: Diffusion models have progressed from latent image synthesis [ 23 ] to video generation with spatiotemporal U-Nets [ 15 , 8 ] , and large-scale video diffusion transformers such as Wan [ 27 ] , LTX-2 [ 13 ] and MiniMax-H3 [ 21 ] now achieve high visual fidelity and motion realism. Controllable generation extends them with camera signals [ 5 ] : MotionCtrl [ 29 ] disentangles camera and object motion, CameraCtrl [ 14 ] encodes camera geometry for trajectory-guided generation, and AC3D [ 4 ] studies how pose conditioning should enter video diffusion models. In all of them, what appears at a new viewpoint is determined by a prior learned implicitly from large-scale data.
blocks.zh: 扩散模型已经从潜在图像合成[23]发展到视频生成,并配有spatimporal U-Nets[15,8],以及Wan [27],LTX-2 [13]和MiniMax-H3 [21]等大规模视频传播变压器,现在实现了高视觉忠诚度和运动现实性. 可控生成以相机信号来扩展它们 [5] : MotionCtrl [29] 分解相机和物体运动,相机Ctrl [14] 为轨迹制导生成编码相机几何,而AC3D [4] 研究外观配置应如何进入视频传播模型. 在所有这些例子中,以新观点出现的情况是由先前从大规模数据中隐含地吸取的教训决定的。

blocks.en: DFoT [ 25 , 10 ] conditions on generation history to keep autoregressive segments continuous, and memory mechanisms extend consistency to longer horizons. Context-as-Memory [ 33 ] retrieves historical frames by camera-view overlap, and WorldMem [ 30 ] reads a memory bank through state-aware attention. GEN3C [ 22 ] , Spatia [ 35 ] and Voyager [ 16 ] maintain explicit point-cloud caches that are rendered at new viewpoints, while latent spatial memory [ 28 ] stores features directly in the diffusion latent space. We share the idea of a persistent 3D memory with these works, but all of them build it through camera projection and depth-based unprojection. For ultrasound, we replace this with compounding, the standard way of assembling tracked cross-sections into a volume [ 24 ] .
blocks.zh: DFoT [25, 10] 关于生成历史的条件,使自递性片段保持连续性,内存机制将一致性延伸至更长的地平线. 上下文-as-Memory [33]通过相机-取景重叠检索了历史帧,而WorldMem [30] 通过国家意识的注意读取了记忆库. GEN3C [22], Spatia [35]和Voyager [16] 保留在新角度上提供的明确的点-云缓存,而潜在的空间内存 [28] 则直接存储在扩散潜在空间中的特征. 我们与这些作品分享了持续3D内存的想法,但它们都通过相机投影和深度不透镜来构建. 对超声波来说,我们用复合体来取而代之,即将有轨横截面集合成一卷[24]的标准方式.

blocks.en: Robotic ultrasound has motivated world models [ 12 ] that relate probe motion to anatomical observations. SonoGym [ 2 ] provides a physics-based simulation environment for policy learning, and Cardiac Copilot [ 18 ] and EchoWorld [ 34 ] learn latent representations of neighboring planes and motion-induced dynamics for probe guidance [ 20 , 7 ] . Generative world models predict ultrasound frames directly. Fan et al . [ 11 ] condition a diffusion model on tracked probe motion for goal-plane navigation. SonoWorld [ 32 ] pretrains on millions of untracked clinical frames, grounds the learned dynamics to EM-tracked probe poses, and generates causally with a KV cache. UltraWorld [ 31 ] synthesizes action–video pairs from 3D anatomical masks and conditions on an acoustic sampling map of per-pixel 3D sampling geometry, similar in spirit to our pose encoding. All of these condition on the probe pose and learn anatomy implicitly; our method additionally provides an explicit updated anatomical prior and a spatial memory of the scanned patient.
blocks.zh: 机器人超声波激发出将探测器运动与解剖观测联系起来的世界模型[12]. SonoGym [2]为政策学习提供了以物理为基础的模拟环境,心动副驾驶[18]和回声世界[34]学习了相邻平面和由运动引起的动力学的潜在表现,用于探测指导[20,7]. 基因世界模型直接预测出超声波帧. Fan 等 [11] 以跟踪探测器运动为条件,进行目标-飞机导航。 SonoWorld [32] 预取了数百万个没有跟踪的临床框架,将所学的动力学推向EM跟踪探测器的外观,并以KV缓存产生因果. UltraWorld [31] 在每像素3D采样几何的相声采样图上,从3D解剖口罩和条件中合成了动作-视频对子,精神上类似于我们的姿势编码. 探测器上的所有这些条件都隐含地摆出并学习解剖学;我们的方法还提供了被扫描的病人的清晰的最新解剖前和空间记忆。

blocks.en: 3.2  Prior and Memory Construction
blocks.zh: 3.2 事前和记忆建筑

blocks.en:
The anatomical prior 𝒜 \mathcal{A} and the memory ℳ \mathcal{M} are two latent volumes in ℝ C × X × Y × Z \mathbb{R}^{C\times X\times Y\times Z} , defined in an anatomical coordinate system shared by all scans of an organ (Sec. 4 ).
The prior estimates plausible anatomy everywhere, including unobserved regions, while the memory stores the latent features generated so far. Both are updated after each chunk and read at the target poses by reslicing (Sec. 3.2.3 ).

blocks.en: 4  Experiment
blocks.zh: 4 实验

blocks.en: 4.1  Experiment Setup
blocks.zh: 4.1 实验设置

blocks.en: We collect freehand ultrasound scans of the thyroid, kidney, and lumbar spine from volunteers under an ethics-approved protocol, with probe poses tracked by an NDI system at about 30 frames per second. All recordings are mapped to a shared anatomical coordinate system through coarse landmark-based alignment, with the origin at a standard landmark of each organ, followed by a subject-level training/test split (thyroid 83/10, kidney 61/23, spine 96/21 recordings).
blocks.zh: 根据道德规范,我们从志愿者那里收集甲状腺、肾和腰椎的免费超声波扫描,NDI系统以每秒约30帧的速度跟踪探测器。 所有录音都通过粗糙的地标式对接来映射到一个共用解剖坐标系统,其出处是每个器官的标准地标,然后是科目一级的训练/测试分解(甲状腺83/10,肾脏61/23,脊椎96/21录音)。

blocks.en: We study pose-conditioned video generation under this aligned-pose setting, with the initial frame’s anatomical pose estimated through landmark-based alignment. Since all later poses are relative to the first frame, only a coarse placement of the scan is required.
blocks.zh: 我们研究在这种对齐的设定下配置的视频生成, 初始帧的解剖功能通过里程碑式的调整来估算。 由于后期所有外观都与第一帧相对,只需要粗放地放置扫描即可.

blocks.en: From each scan we sample three types of training trajectories, each emphasizing one source of information. Sweeps advance into unscanned tissue, where the model must rely on the prior. Returns revisit scanned regions, where it must rely on the memory. Turns rotate the probe between transverse and longitudinal views, where unseen planes must be inferred from both.
blocks.zh: 从每次扫描中,我们抽取了三种类型的训练轨迹,每种都强调一个信息来源。 冲入未被扫描的组织,其中模型必须依赖前作. 返回必须依靠记忆的扫描区域。 将探测器旋转在横向和纵向视图之间,其中必须从两者中推断出看不见的飞机。

blocks.en: We compare with four pose-conditioned video models that span the design space of memory: CameraCtrl [ 14 ] keeps no memory; WorldMem [ 30 ] retrieves past frames by pose and fuses them through memory attention; CaM [ 33 ] retrieves co-visible frames and appends them to the context; Gen3C [ 22 ] maintains a pixel-space 3D cache. For a fair comparison, all baselines are retrained on our data with the same input, and every memory holds the method’s own generations. Two components are adapted from natural images to ultrasound. (i) Pose embedding : per-pixel viewing rays are replaced by the per-pixel 3D coordinates of the imaging plane, as in ours. (ii) Memory storage : frames are placed in 3D by their known plane geometry (compounding) instead of depth-based unprojection, and retrieval follows plane overlap.
blocks.zh: 我们比较了四个横跨内存设计空间的假想视频模型: CameraCtrl [14] 保存不内存; WorldMem [30] 通过外观取回过去的帧,并通过内存的注意来导出; CAM [33] 取回同可见帧并附入上下文; Gen3C [22] 维持一个像素-空格 3D缓存. 为了进行公平的比较,所有基线都用同样的输入重新调整了我们的数据,每一个记忆都持有这个方法自己的几代人。 两个组件从自然图像被改编为超声波. (一) Pose嵌入:每像素取景射线被成像平面的每像素3D坐标所取代,如我们的. (二)内存存储:帧被其已知平面几何(拼接)放入3D中,而不是以深度为主的不投影,取回时会跟随平面重叠.

blocks.en:
We evaluate anatomical consistency on each organ from three complementary aspects.
(i) Fidelity measures whether generated anatomy matches real scans, using FID and FVD for realism and LPIPS against ground truth in newly scanned regions.
(ii) Revisit consistency measures whether the same anatomy is preserved when the probe returns over a scanned region with a slight rotation: each revisited frame is compared in PSNR and LPIPS with the real scan.
(iii) Pose following measures whether anatomical structures change consistently with probe motion, using the ratio of observed to commanded displacement of an organ-specific landmark under certain lateral shifts.
Beyond these metrics, we assess perceived realism in a blinded expert rating , in which sonographers score each method’s videos on a 1–5 scale (Sc.).
blocks.zh:
我们从三个相辅相成的方面评估每个机构的解剖一致性。
(一) 利用FID和FVD对新被扫描区域的地面真相进行真实性和LPIPS,测量生成的解剖学是否匹配真实扫描。
(二)在探测器返回到一个略微旋转的被扫描区域时,重新检查是否保留了相同的解剖学一致性:每个被重新审视的框架在PSNR和LPIPS中与真正的扫描进行比较.
(三) 利用在某些平移下观察到的器官特定地标与受命转移的比率,对解剖结构是否与探测器运动一致变化进行测量。
除了这些衡量标准之外,我们用盲目的专家评分来评估所看到的现实主义,其中的声学家对每种方法的视频评分为1到5分(Sc.

blocks.en: 4.2  Performance Against Baselines
blocks.zh: 4.2 对照基线的业绩

blocks.en:
We measure image-level and temporal realism with FID and FVD, and accuracy on regions seen for the first time with LPIPS (see Fidelity in Tab. 1 ).
Our method obtains the lowest FID on all three organs and the lowest FVD on Thyroid and Spine, trailing only Gen3C [ 22 ] in FVD on Kidney.
Its LPIPS on new regions is the lowest on Thyroid and Kidney and ties with Gen3C on Spine.
CameraCtrl [ 14 ] and WorldMem [ 30 ] produce far less realistic videos, which we attribute mainly to their backbones: a UNet-based diffusion model [ 14 ] pretrained on natural videos that transfers poorly to ultrasound, and a much smaller Diffusion Transformer with limited capacity for fine ultrasound texture [ 30 ] .
CaM and Gen3C, re-implemented on our Wan2.2-5B backbone and fine-tuned on ultrasound, generally reach competitive fidelity.

我们用FID和FVD来衡量图像水平和时间现实性,以及第一次用LPIPS衡量的区域的准确性(见Tab. 1中的Fidelity)。
我们的方法得到了所有三个器官中最低的FID,以及甲状腺和斯宾克上最低的FVD,在Kidney上的FVD中仅排名Gen3C [22].

CameraCtrl [14]和WorldMem [30] 制作的现实性小得多的视频,我们主要归结于他们的骨干:一个基于UNet的传播模型 [14] 预先在自然视频上训练,这些视频向超声波传输不良,以及一个容量有限的精细超声波纹理的更小的传播变形器 [30].
CAM和Gen3C,在我们Wan2.2-5B骨干上重新执行,在超声波上进行微调,一般达到有竞争力的忠诚.

blocks.en:
When the probe returns over a scanned region along a tilted path, we compare each generated frame with the real scan (see Revisit in Tab. 1 ).
CameraCtrl [ 14 ] has no memory and therefore cannot recall earlier content.
WorldMem [ 30 ] shows that memory alone is not sufficient: feeding a few retrieved past frames through attention remains a weak constraint, and its revisit scores are no better than those of CameraCtrl on Thyroid and Spine.
CaM [ 33 ] and Gen3C [ 22 ] , with memory adapted to ultrasound geometry, are the closest competitors, yet our 3D latent memory is best on Thyroid and Kidney in both PSNR and LPIPS.
On Spine it ties with Gen3C in LPIPS and is within 0.14 dB in PSNR.
blocks.zh:
当探测器沿着倾斜路径在被扫描区域上返回时,我们将每个生成的帧与真实的扫描进行比较(参见Tab. 1中的Revisit).
CameraCtrl [14] 没有记忆,因此无法回顾更早的内容.
WorldMem [30] 显示仅靠记忆是不够的:通过关注来喂食一些被检索过的帧仍然是一个薄弱的制约因素,它的再审分数并不比Thyroid和Spine上的相机Ctrl好.
CAM [33]和Gen3C [22],内存被适应了超声波几何,是最接近的竞争对手,然而我们的3D潜在内存却在PSNR和LPIPS中都对Thyroid和Kidney都是最好的.
在斯宾克岛,它与LPIPS中的Gen3C有联系,在PSNR的0.14 dB范围内.

blocks.en:
This metric asks whether the generated anatomy actually follows the scan path: we shift the path laterally by ± Δ ​ x \pm\Delta x and measure, how far the target anatomy moves relative to the commanded shift (1 = perfect following).
None of the baselines uses an anatomical prior, and all of them follow the path poorly.
WorldMem, CaM, and Gen3C almost fail (at most 0.22), and CameraCtrl, the best baseline, reaches only 0.25–0.49.
This suggests that a pose signal alone is too weak a condition: the model learns a plausible motion prior but not how the anatomy should change with the probe position.
Fig. 3 shows a typical thyroid case.
When the probe moves left or right, our carotid artery moves in the opposite direction in the image, as it should, by roughly 6 mm for an 8 mm probe shift; Gen3C keeps it at the same position in all three sweeps despite its explicit 3D cache.
With the anatomical prior, our method improves following markedly on every organ (0.73, 0.68, and 0.43 on thyroid, kidney, and spine), consistent with the ablation in Tab. 3 .

WorldMem, CAM,和Gen3C几乎失败(最多为0.22),相机Ctrl作为最佳基线,只达到0.25–0.49.
这表明,单是姿势信号就太弱了,这是个条件:模型先学会了一种可能的运动,但解剖应如何随探测器位置而改变。
图3显示了典型的甲状腺病例.

blocks.en: Five sonographers each rated all 180 videos: 30 test cases (ten per organ, covering back-and-forth sweeps, probe turns and short sweeps), each shown as the real recording and the generations of the five methods. Videos are shown one at a time in random order without method names, and each is scored from 1 (definitely generated) to 5 (definitely real), so the score reflects whether a whole clip, including its consistency as the probe moves, passes as a real scan. Our videos receive the highest score among all generators (4.25, versus 3.89 for Gen3C and 3.73 for CaM; Tab. 1 ), approaching the real recordings (4.49). Details are given in the supplementary material.

blocks.en: 4.3  Ablation Study
blocks.zh: 4.3 读取研究

blocks.en: All ablations are conducted on thyroid data. Each variant shares the backbone, training data, training budget and sampler of the full model and differs from it in a single component. We use the metrics of Tab. 1 and extend revisit consistency with a second reference: besides the real scan (GT), each revisited frame is also compared with the model’s own earlier generation at the same pose (Self). GT measures whether revisited anatomy is correct, whereas Self measures whether the model remembers what it generated, independently of whether that was correct. Each claim is evaluated on the test that targets it, and only variants that differ in the component under study are compared.
blocks.zh: 所有涂片都根据甲状腺数据进行。 每个变体都共享整个模型的骨干,培训数据,培训预算和采样器,并在一个组成部分中与之相异. 我们使用 Tab. 1 的衡量标准, 并延长重温与第二个参考的一致性:除了真正的扫描(GT)之外, 每个重温的帧也会与模型本身的早期的相提并论。 GT测量重回解剖学是否正确,而自量模型是否记住它产生的东西,而不管它是否正确. 每项索赔都通过针对索赔的测试加以评估,并且只比较研究组成部分中不同的变体。

blocks.en:
The upper part of Tab. 3 starts from pose control alone and adds the two proposed components.
With pose control alone, the model learns only a generic motion prior of how scans typically evolve: it barely follows the probe and produces the least realistic videos, since the pose tells it where the probe is, but not what anatomy to expect there.
The anatomical prior supplies this missing knowledge, markedly improving pose following (Fol. 0.10 → \rightarrow 0.58) and generation realism (FID 40.2 → \rightarrow 30.7).
The memory instead lets the model remember: Self PSNR rises by about 10 dB, so revisited regions reproduce what was generated before. Remembering, however, is not being correct. Without the prior, a thyroid that should appear beside the carotid artery as the probe moves forward (Fig. 1 ) may never be generated, and the memory then faithfully repeats this error on the way back, leaving GT PSNR unchanged.
Only with both, the prior for plausible anatomy and the memory for consistent revisits, does generation become anatomically consistent, with the best result on all metrics.
blocks.zh:
Tab. 3的上半部分从单装控制开始,并添加了两个拟议组件.
单凭姿势控制,模型只学会了一般的扫描进化过程的通俗运动:它几乎不跟随探测器,制作出最不现实的视频,因为姿势告诉它探测器的位置,而不是解剖学对那里的期望.
解剖学的先导提供了这种缺失的知识,显著改进了其后的姿势(Fol.0.10 → 右手0.58)和一代现实主义(FID 40.2 → 右手 30.7)。
而不是让模型记住: 自我PSNR上升了大约10分贝,因此重新审视的地区复制了以前产生的. 然而,记忆是不正确的。 没有前一种,在探测器前进时应该出现在颈动脉旁的甲状腺可能永远不会产生出(图1),记忆在返回途中忠实地重复了这个错误,使得GT PSNR保持不变.
只有在两种情况下,即前一种可以进行合理解剖,而后一种可以进行一致的重访,这代人才会在解剖学上趋于一致,在所有度量衡上都有最佳的结果。

blocks.en:
The memory provides fine-grained information for each token, whereas the prior is only a coarse population estimate of the layout. We therefore concatenate the memory with the input and add the prior to the early blocks (Sec. 3.3 ).
The lower part of Tab. 3 keeps both conditions and changes only how they are injected.
When both are injected in the same form, either layer-wise or concatenated, combining them hurts rather than helps: FID becomes worse than with the memory alone (31.2) or the prior alone (30.7).
Sharing one pathway makes the two conditions compete, so the model cannot use both at full strength.
Dual injection removes this conflict. Each condition keeps its own pathway, and their benefits add up: it is the only variant that improves on both single-condition models, with the largest gain in pose following.
blocks.zh:
内存为每个符提供精细的信息,而前作只是粗糙的人口对布局的估计. 因此,我们将内存与输入结合,并添加到早期区块之前(第3.3条)。
塔布的下部部分. 3只保留条件和改变其注射方式。
当两者以同一种形式注射时,无论是分层注射还是分层注射,结合它们会伤害而不是帮助: 光是内存(31.2)或仅前一种(30.7),FID就变得更糟。
共享一条路径使得两个条件相互竞争,因此模型不能完全使用两者.
双打可以消除此冲突. 每个条件都保持自己的路径,其好处加在一起:这是在两个单一条件模式上都得到改进的唯一变体,其最大收益如下。

blocks.en:
We add our prior and memory to three video diffusion backbones of different architecture and size: Wan2.2-5B, LTX2.5-22B and Wan2.1-14B (Tab. 3 ).
Scaling up the backbone alone does not help: all three base models fail to follow the probe (Fol. ≤ \leq 0.10) or recall revisited anatomy (Self ≤ \leq 18.3 dB), and the larger ones are no better than Wan2.2-5B.
With our conditioning, every backbone improves in realism, revisit consistency and, most clearly, pose following (Fol. 0.73–0.80).
This is consistent with the premise of this work: with scarce ultrasound data, a larger model does not learn the missing anatomical knowledge implicitly, whereas providing it explicitly improves every backbone.
blocks.zh:
我们将我们的前身和内存添加到三个不同建筑和大小的视频传播主干线上:Wan2.2-5B,LTX2.5-22B和Wan2.1-14B(第3段.
扩大主干线本身无济于事:所有三个基模型都未能跟踪探测器(Fol. \\leq 0.10)或召回重回重回的解剖学(Self \leq 18.3 dB),而较大的基模型并不比Wan2.2-5B更好.
随着我们的调整,每个骨干在现实主义中都有所改进,重新审视一致性,而且最明显的是,它构成一个随从(Fol. 0.73-0.80)。
这符合这项工作的前提:由于超声波数据稀少,一个更大的模型不会隐含地学习缺失的解剖学知识,而提供它则明确改进了每一个骨干.

blocks.en: Like our expectation of an unfamiliar room, the prior should become specific to the subject as the scan proceeds. A static prior cannot: it conditions every chunk on the population mean 𝝁 \boldsymbol{\mu} , which carries little information about the specific subject. Our prior instead is updated after every chunk (Eq. 4 ). Fig. 4 compares the two on long thyroid scans. On the left, the prior error is the relative squared error between the prior resliced at each chunk and the real latents of that chunk. Before anything has been observed, the two priors coincide; once the first chunk has been generated, the error of the updated prior drops below that of the static one and stays lower. Generation performance follows the same trend, and the model with the updated prior degrades more slowly over the rollout (FID). On the right, we evaluate full rollouts with the protocols of Tab. 3 : the updated prior also improves pose following and revisit consistency.
blocks.zh: 和我们对陌生房间的期望一样 扫描开始后,前一个房间应该 成为特定的主题 静态前缀不能:它给人口构成每个块意味着μ\ boldsymbol\mu}, 我们的前身是在每个块后更新的(Eq. 4)。 图4在长甲状腺扫描上比较了两者. 在左边,前一个错误是每个块的上一个重刻出与该块的真正潜伏之间的相对平方错误. 在任何事物被观测到之前,两个前缀重合;一旦第一个块被生成,更新后的前缀错误会低于静态的后缀并保持低. 生成性能也遵循同一趋势,采用更新的前作的模型比推出(FID)更缓慢地降解. 在右边,我们用 Tab. 3 的协议来评价全面推出情况: 更新的先前协议还提出了如下改进,并重新审视一致性。

blocks.en: 4.4  Qualitative Results: Beyond Recorded Scans
blocks.zh: 4.4 定性结果:超出记录的扫描

blocks.en: The model is not limited to reproducing recorded scans: from a single frame it generates diverse new scans, and from a real sweep it generates unscanned planes that were never acquired (Fig. 5 ).
blocks.zh: 该模型并不限于复制所记录的扫描:它从一个单一的框架产生不同的新扫描,从一个真正的扫描中产生从未获得的未扫描飞机(图5).

blocks.en: Since the probe path is an input to the model, it can be freely defined rather than recorded; here we use a sweep followed by a turn. Given one real frame, the model generates the whole scan, and changing the seed changes the sampled anatomy while the probe pose stays the same. In Fig. 5 a, the three seeds produce thyroid lobes that differ in shape, echotexture and vessel layout, yet within each seed the transverse and longitudinal views agree at their intersection (dashed lines), i.e . , each sample is a consistent 3D anatomy rather than a set of independent frames. Such diverse scans can enrich the scarce ultrasound training data with plausible anatomical variation, e.g . , for training ultrasound world models.
blocks.zh: 由于探测道是对模型的输入,所以可以自由定义而不是记录;这里我们使用一扫再转. 考虑到一个真实的框架,模型生成整个扫描,而改变种子会改变被取样的解剖学,而探测器的姿势则保持不变. 在图5a中,这三种种子产生的甲状腺叶片形状、回声纹理和容器布局不同,然而在每个种子中,横向和纵向观点在相交点(干线)上一致,即每个样本都是一致的3D解剖学,而不是一套独立的框架。 这种多样化的扫描可以以合理的解剖变异来丰富稀少的超声波训练数据,例如,用于培训超声波世界模型。

blocks.en:
Freehand scanning is never steady, leaving gaps and tilts between neighboring slices, so the reslice at a new plane is blurred or smeared (Compound in Fig. 5 b).
Just as the probe path, the memory can also be supplied from outside rather than built from generated frames. We therefore encode the real sweep with the VAE, compound its latents into the memory (Eq. 5 ) and update the prior from it, exactly as for generated chunks. The model then generates along a target path that moves the probe from the sweep to the new plane, e.g . , by rotating it, conditioned on both the memory and the updated prior. It recovers sharp texture and fine structures lost in the compound (zoom-ins), correcting compounding errors and yielding more realistic images than reslicing alone.
blocks.zh:
自由手扫描从未稳定,在相邻的切片之间留下了缺口和倾斜,因此新平面上的重接被模糊或被抹去(Compound in Fig. 5b.).
正如探测道一样,内存也可以由外部提供,而不是由所生成的框架来构建. 因此,我们用VAE编码真实的扫荡,将它的潜入内存(Eq. 5)并更新其前作,与生成的块完全相同. 该模型然后沿着目标路径生成,将探测器从扫地到新平面移动,例如通过旋转来生成,同时以内存和被更新的前作为条件. 它恢复了化合物(zoom-ins)中丢失的尖端纹理和细细的结构,纠正了复合错误并产生了比单独再生更现实的图像.

blocks.en: 5  Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: Video generation models anticipate unseen content from priors learned implicitly from large-scale data. For anatomically consistent ultrasound video generation, this is insufficient: probe pose tells the model where to scan, but not what anatomy to expect, and scarce ultrasound data prevent learning this implicitly. We provide the generator with two parts of a sonographer’s mental model: an anatomical prior, refined online by each generated chunk, for unscanned regions, and a 3D latent memory built by compounding for scanned regionspreviously generated frames for scanned regions. Together, they keep the generated anatomy plausible where nothing has been scanned yet and consistent where it has been scanned before. Our evaluation focuses on generation fidelity and anatomical consistency, leaving its effectiveness for embodied planning, where generated views guide the probe motion, untested. In future work, we plan to use it as a world model for robotic ultrasound, e.g . , to train and evaluate probe-navigation policies or plan probe motions by predicting candidate views and selecting the path that best reaches a target view [ 3 ] .
blocks.zh: 视频生成模型预想着从大规模数据中隐含地学到的前科的内容。 对于解剖学上一致的超声波视频生成来说,这是不足的:探测器的姿势告诉模型在哪里扫描,但不是解剖学所期望的,而稀缺的超声波数据阻止了对这一点的隐含了解. 我们向发电机提供一个音响学家心理模型的两个部分:一个是解剖前的,由每个生成块在线精炼,用于未扫描区域,另一个是3D潜在内存,由扫描区域之前生成的被扫描区域框架复合而成。 他们把生成的解剖学 放在没有扫描过的地方 和以前扫描过的地方保持一致 我们的评估侧重于生成忠心和解剖的一致性,而其有效性则留给体现的规划,其中所产生的观点指导了探测器的运动,但没有经过测试。 在今后的工作中,我们计划将其作为机器人超声波的世界模型,例如,通过预测候选观点和选择最能达到目标观点的路径来训练和评价探测导航政策或计划探测运动.
